\section{\texttt{build\_retriever}}
\label{func:feedback_intelligence_agent.factory.build_retriever}\index{Functions!build\_retriever}

Construct the configured retriever over an existing vector store.
\apifield{Usage}
\begin{lstlisting}[style=usage, language=Python]
build_retriever(settings: Settings, vector_store: VectorStore) -> Retriever
\end{lstlisting}
\apifield{Arguments}
\begin{arglist}
  \item[\texttt{settings}] \texttt{Settings}, required.
  \item[\texttt{vector\_\allowbreak{}store}] \texttt{VectorStore}, required.
\end{arglist}
\apifield{Value}\texttt{Retriever}
\apifield{Details}\texttt{dense} keeps the original vector-similarity behaviour, \texttt{lexical} uses the local BM25 index, and \texttt{hybrid} combines both with the configured \texttt{dense\_\allowbreak{}weight} and \texttt{lexical\_\allowbreak{}weight}.
